items.title: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant Review: Rice-Based Exfoliant With Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant: a rice-based exfoliating powder that activates with water, recommended for all skin types, including skin with blemishes and blackheads.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant: what's in it, who it's for and how to use it.
facts: Rice-based exfoliating powder, rich in AHAs, that activates on contact with water (13 g, 40 g, 74 g and 74 g refill)
Releases papain, salicylic acid and rice bran to polish skin; removes dulling surface debris and evens skin tone
Skin Brightening Complex of phytic acid from rice bran, white tea and licorice helps balance uneven skin tone
Colloidal oatmeal and allantoin help calm skin; gentle enough for daily use
Recommended for all skin types; listed for blemishes and blackheads, dullness, uneven texture and uneven skin tone
Use about a half-teaspoon in very wet hands, apply in circular motions avoiding the eyes, massage for one minute and rinse; adjust frequency if you experience irritation

scenes.caption: Daily Microfoliant
scenes.say: Blemishes, blackheads, dull or uneven skin? Then this exfoliant is worth a closer look. This is the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant. In this video we'll cover what it is, what's inside, who it's for, and how to use it step by step.

scenes.caption: Rice-based powder
scenes.say: First, what it is. Daily Microfoliant is an exfoliating powder made from rice, and it's rich in alpha hydroxy acids.

scenes.caption: Activates with water
scenes.say: It stays a dry powder in the jar. The moment it meets water, it activates.

scenes.caption: Papain, salicylic acid
scenes.say: When it activates, it releases papain, salicylic acid and rice bran, which polish the skin.

scenes.caption: Removes surface debris
scenes.say: Together they remove the dulling debris that sits on the surface of your skin, and they help even out skin tone.

scenes.caption: Skin Brightening Complex
scenes.say: Next is the Skin Brightening Complex. It combines phytic acid from rice bran with white tea and licorice, and it helps balance uneven skin tone.

scenes.caption: Oatmeal and allantoin
scenes.say: For comfort, there's colloidal oatmeal and allantoin, which help calm the skin.

scenes.caption: Gentle for daily use
scenes.say: That calming side is why it's gentle enough to use every day, which is where the name Daily Microfoliant comes from.

scenes.caption: Blemishes and blackheads
scenes.say: So who is it for? It's recommended for all skin types, and it's listed for blemishes and blackheads, dullness, uneven texture and uneven skin tone.

scenes.caption: Half a teaspoon
scenes.say: Now, how to use it. Shake about half a teaspoon of the powder into very wet hands.

scenes.caption: Circular motions
scenes.say: Rub your hands together until it turns creamy, then apply it to your face in circular motions. Avoid the eye area.

scenes.caption: Massage one minute
scenes.say: Massage gently for about one minute, then rinse thoroughly.

scenes.caption: If irritation happens
scenes.say: If you notice any irritation, use it less often until your skin is comfortable.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: It comes in thirteen gram, forty gram and seventy-four gram sizes, and there's a seventy-four gram refill too. So, to recap: a rice-based powder that activates with water, with papain, salicylic acid and rice bran to polish, a brightening complex for uneven tone, and oatmeal and allantoin to keep it calm enough for daily use. That's the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant Review: Charcoal Exfoliant for Oily Skin, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant: a highly active resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant, best for normal, combination and oily skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant: what's in it, who it's for and how to use it.
facts: Highly active resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant (13 g, 57 g and 57 g refill)
Resurfaces and deep cleanses; adsorbs environmental pollutants and helps detoxify pores
Releases AHAs on contact with water; activated binchotan charcoal purifies the skin
Niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract help guard against pollution's effects
Best for normal, combination and oily skin; not ideal for very sensitive or compromised skin
Use about a half-teaspoon in very wet hands, apply in circular motions avoiding the eyes, massage for one minute and rinse with warm water; use daily, or on alternate days for more sensitive skin

scenes.caption: Daily Superfoliant
scenes.say: If you have oily or combination skin and want an exfoliant that also deep cleans your pores, stay with me. This is the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant. I'll go through what it is, the key ingredients, who it suits, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Resurfacing powder
scenes.say: It's a highly active resurfacing powder exfoliant, made with an anti-pollution focus.

scenes.caption: Deep cleanses
scenes.say: It does two jobs at once. It resurfaces the skin, and it deep cleanses. Both happen in the same one-minute step.

scenes.caption: AHAs with water
scenes.say: Like other powder exfoliants, it activates with water. On contact, it releases alpha hydroxy acids.

scenes.caption: Binchotan charcoal
scenes.say: One of its key ingredients is activated binchotan charcoal, which purifies the skin.

scenes.caption: Helps detoxify pores
scenes.say: It adsorbs environmental pollutants, and it helps detoxify your pores. That's the deep cleansing part.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide
scenes.say: Then there's a trio of niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract.

scenes.caption: Red algae, tara fruit
scenes.say: Together, these three help guard your skin against the effects of pollution, which is what makes this an anti-pollution exfoliant.

scenes.caption: Normal to oily skin
scenes.say: So who is it for? It's best for normal, combination and oily skin. It's not ideal for very sensitive or compromised skin.

scenes.caption: Half a teaspoon
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Put about half a teaspoon of the powder into very wet hands.

scenes.caption: Circular motions
scenes.say: Rub your hands together to make a creamy paste, then apply it to your face in circular motions, keeping away from the eyes.

scenes.caption: Rinse with warm water
scenes.say: Massage gently for one minute, then rinse well with warm water.

scenes.caption: Daily or alternate days
scenes.say: It's made to be used daily, as part of your normal routine. If your skin is more sensitive, start on alternate days instead, and build up from there.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: It comes in a thirteen gram and a fifty-seven gram size, plus a fifty-seven gram refill. So, to recap: a resurfacing powder that releases alpha hydroxy acids with water, activated binchotan charcoal to purify, and niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract against pollution, made for normal, combination and oily skin. That's the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant. The link is in the description.
